Okay, so I'm trying to figure out who Jokshan's father married after Sarah's death. I remember that in the Bible, Abraham had several wives. The main ones are Sarah and Hagar. Sarah was his first wife, and after she died, Abraham took Hagar as his second wife. Hagar is also known as Keturah in some texts. 

Wait, so Jokshan is one of the sons of Abraham, right? I think he's mentioned in Genesis, maybe in the part where Abraham has children by Keturah. So if Jokshan's father is Abraham, and after Sarah's death, Abraham married Hagar, then Jokshan must be one of the sons from that second marriage.

I'm a bit confused because sometimes Hagar and Keturah are used interchangeably, but I think they're the same person. So, putting it all together, after Sarah died, Abraham married Hagar, and they had children, including Jokshan. So the answer should be that Jokshan's father married Hagar after Sarah's death.

I'm not entirely sure if there's any other possible interpretation, but I think this is the correct one based on what I know from the Bible stories.
